links.outcome: Completeness and conformity of chatbot pediatric BLS answers to AHA 2020 guidelines
links.effect: Only 9.61% fully addressed and 5.77% fully conformed to AHA 2020 pediatric BLS guidelines; 61.54% partially addressed; 59.61% conformed only partially; 5.77% not addressed.
links.quote: Content analysis of ChatGPT responses revealed that only 9.61% were fully addressed, and just 5.77% fully conformed to the AHA 2020 pediatric BLS guidelines.

screen.reason: Evaluates performance of ChatGPT-4o and ChatGPT-4o mini on pediatric basic life support questions against AHA guidelines without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or guardrail.
